+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8180'
+title: Limit the executor prompt cache memory tier by bytes, with a limit the host sets, and remove maximumRetainedSessions
+---
+#prompt-cache
+
+## What
+
+`ExecutorPromptCacheStore` (`Libraries/MLXFoundationModels/ExecutorPromptCache.swift:88`) keeps at most `maximumRetainedSessions = 4` sessions (`:99`) and drops the least recently used entry in `checkIn` (`:134-136`). A count of sessions is the wrong unit: one 32k-token session can be larger than twenty short ones. The FoundationModelsRouter host will size the limit from its pool memory budget, and can change it while it runs. Remove the count completely. Do not replace it with another fixed count.
+
+- Add `var byteCount: Int` to `ExecutorPromptCacheEntry`: the sum of `nbytes` of every array in `caches.flatMap(\.state)`, plus the arrays of `state?.serializedArrays()` (`Libraries/MLXLMCommon/LanguageModel.swift:253`). Compute it once in `init`, because the arrays do not change while the entry is in the store.
+- Replace `maximumRetainedSessions` with `private(set) var memoryByteLimit: Int`, initial value `ExecutorPromptCacheStore.defaultMemoryByteLimit = 2 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024` (2 GiB).
+- Add `func setMemoryByteLimit(_ bytes: Int)`. It applies the limit at once: it evicts least-recently-used entries until the total is at or below the new limit.
+- `checkIn` keeps a running `retainedByteCount`. After the insert, it evicts least-recently-used entries (not the entry just checked in, unless it alone is larger than the limit) until `retainedByteCount <= memoryByteLimit`.
+- Every eviction goes through ONE private function `spill(_ key:, _ entry:)`. In this task it only drops the entry. The disk-tier task replaces its body, thus no other code path drops an entry.
+- `retainedSessionCount` stays for tests. Add `var retainedByteCount: Int` for tests.
+- Do not add public API in this task. The public setting comes in the API task.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] `maximumRetainedSessions` does not exist anywhere in `Libraries/` or `Tests/`.
+- [ ] With a limit of N bytes, the store never holds more than N bytes after a `checkIn` returns, except when one entry alone is larger than N (then the store holds zero entries: that entry is spilled at once).
+- [ ] Eviction order is least recently used first; a `checkOut` followed by `checkIn` makes an entry most recently used.
+- [ ] `setMemoryByteLimit` to a smaller value evicts at once; to a larger value evicts nothing.
+- [ ] `evict(modelID:)` keeps `retainedByteCount` correct.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Update `Tests/MLXFoundationModelsTests/ExecutorPromptCacheTests.swift`: replace the test that reads `maximumRetainedSessions` (`:155`) with byte-limit tests that use entries of known size (for example `KVCacheSimple` with fixed-shape float16 keys/values).
+- [ ] Add tests: LRU order by bytes, one oversized entry, limit lowered at run time, `byteCount` includes `LMOutput.State` arrays, `evict(modelID:)` keeps the byte total.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXFoundationModelsTests.xctest` — all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
